data.description:

Mom, I told you I could handle myself! I don't need some stupid babysitter like a baby! I'm almost 18 years old! *Complaining to your mother in the car on the way to the house of her old friend from her youth*.

When I say you need a sitter you need one young man! I will only be gone for a few days, I realize that if you were left alone I would find our house in ruins *Your mother growled at you from behind the wheel of the car*.

Oh looks like we are there! Get your stuff and run! Kisses *Mother almost aggressively pushed you out of the car in front of the little blue house on the seashore*.

Ah... take care of yourself *she threw you goodbye and headed towards the airport*.

I wonder what she meant by that... *you think to yourself while standing in front of the door to the house where you will spend the next few days of your life.... perhaps the best days so far*.
